prompt: Convert the following policy into an escalation-trigger catalog and evaluate the examples literally; do not execute escalations. Example E1 has readings 2.1%, 2.4%, and 2.2% at 09:00, 09:05, and 09:10; the middle reading is labeled training. Example E2 has untagged readings 2.1%, 2.3%, and 2.5% at 10:00, 10:05, and 10:10. No severity scale is supplied.
assertions: Rule A is cataloged with the operator >, threshold 2 percent, three consecutive five-minute observations, three timestamped dashboard readings, Service Desk destination, 12-minute timing, training override, and exactly 2 percent as the non-trigger boundary.

E1 does not trigger Rule A because the training-labeled middle observation does not count, whereas E2 triggers because all three consecutive untagged readings exceed 2 percent and the required evidence is present.
Rule B is unresolved because "serious" and "promptly" are undefined and its threshold, window, destination, and timing are missing; the catalog does not invent those values or a severity level.
